turns.query: Identify the air quality monitoring station that recorded the highest PM10 concentration at 14:00:00 on October 5, 2025. What was the average recorded traffic speed across all road segments within 500 meters of this station at that exact same time (rounded to 1 decimal place)?
turns.actual_response:
The air quality monitoring station with the highest PM10 concentration at 14:00 on October 5, 2025 was Causeway Bay, with PM10 of 35.7 µg/m³.

Across 84 road-segment traffic records within 500 meters of that station at the same time, the average recorded traffic speed was 53.3 km/h.
code_snippets:
import pandas as pd
from sqlalchemy import text

ts = "2025-10-05 14:00:00"

# Identify the station with the highest PM10 at the specified hour
q_station = text("""
SELECT s.id, s.name_en, h.pm10
FROM hourly_station_air_quality h
JOIN air_quality_station s ON s.id = h.station_id
WHERE h.datetime = :ts AND h.pm10 IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY h.pm10 DESC
LIMIT 1
""")
top_station = pd.read_sql(q_station, engine, params={"ts": ts})

if top_station.empty:
    avg_speed_near_pm10 = None
    print("No PM10 readings found for the specified time.")
else:
    station_id = int(top_station.loc[0, "id"])
    station_name = top_station.loc[0, "name_en"]
    max_pm10 = float(top_station.loc[0, "pm10"])

    # Count traffic records within 500m at the same hour before aggregation
    q_count = text("""
    SELECT COUNT(*) AS n_segments
    FROM hourly_road_segment_traffic t
    JOIN road_segment r ON r.id = t.road_segment_id
    JOIN air_quality_station s ON s.id = :station_id
    WHERE t.datetime = :ts
      AND t.speed IS NOT NULL
      AND ST_DWithin(r.geometry::geography, s.coordinate, 500)
    """)
    n_segments = int(pd.read_sql(q_count, engine, params={"station_id": station_id, "ts": ts}).loc[0, "n_segments"])

    # Aggregate average traffic speed within 500m at the same hour
    q_avg = text("""
    SELECT AVG(t.speed)::float AS avg_speed
    FROM hourly_road_segment_traffic t
    JOIN road_segment r ON r.id = t.road_segment_id
    JOIN air_quality_station s ON s.id = :station_id
    WHERE t.datetime = :ts
      AND t.speed IS NOT NULL
      AND ST_DWithin(r.geometry::geography, s.coordinate, 500)
    """)
    avg_val = pd.read_sql(q_avg, engine, params={"station_id": station_id, "ts": ts}).loc[0, "avg_speed"]
    avg_speed_near_pm10 = None if pd.isna(avg_val) else round(float(avg_val), 1)

    print(f"Station with highest PM10: {station_name}")
    print(f"Highest PM10 at {ts}: {max_pm10:.1f} µg/m³")
    print(f"Traffic records within 500 m at same time: {n_segments}")
    print(f"Average traffic speed within 500 m: {avg_speed_near_pm10}")
